notes: Families group by how they play (game math), not CR implementation.
plan_role: condition | engine | enabler | payoff | modifier | cost | protection
math_kind names the equation the family changes.
New Scryfall catalog names missing here are unreviewed — place ~10-15/year by hand.

(2026-08-06): remainder triage placed all 91 leftover catalog names. Generic CR action verbs (Play, Tap, Untap, Shuffle, Reveal) sit in timing; removal verbs (Exile, Sacrifice, Fight, Exchange, Sweep) in interaction — Scryfall catalog entries, not synergy keywords.

thresholds_battlefield.description: Board-state gates. Payoffs fire when a countable board predicate is true.

thresholds_turn_event.description: Something happened this turn — binary or counted event gates.

batching.description: Card is in a named set (Historic, Modified, Outlaw). Lineage matters.

variables.description: Scalars read off the game state (devotion, domain, party).

cast_from_graveyard.description: Yard is a second hand — changes effective card advantage math.

return_from_graveyard.description: Recursion to hand/battlefield without casting as the primary mode.

alternate_costs.description: Replace or reshape the mana price of a spell.

additional_costs.description: Pay something extra for a mode or bonus.

delayed_recast.description: Cast once, get another use later.

when_you_cast.description: Value scales with spell velocity / storm-like chains.

evasion.description: Changes which blockers are legal — attack connection rate.

combat_timing.description: Strike order / vigilance — changes combat assignment math.

attacking_triggers.description: Value on attack declaration — rewards go-wide or go-tall aggression.

saboteur.description: Value on dealing combat damage to a player.

damage_modification.description: Changes what damage does (life, counters, kill).

protection.description: Keeps permanents / player state alive through interaction.

spell_cast_triggers.description: Triggers off casting — prowess family and cousins.

dies_triggers.description: Value on death — aristocrats math (sac outlets × drain).

tokens.description: Creates bodies. Creature tokens feed go-wide (attackers, sac, convoke) and go-tall (anthem/counter payoffs). Resource tokens (Treasure, Clue, Food) are a different equation — mana/card/life, not board presence.

face_down.description: Hidden information / cheap body now, pay later.

hand_abilities.description: Discard/cycle for effect — changes hand-as-resource math.

library_manipulation.description: Orders or filters the deck — reduces variance of draws.

new_components.description: Introduces a tracked component (monarch, initiative, dungeons).

timing.description: When you can cast — interaction windows.

life_math.description: Lifegain / drain composition. Mostly oracle_signals; Lifelink keyword sits in damage_modification and also feeds this plan.

energy.description: Energy counters ({E}). Produce via get {E}; spend via pay {E}. No Scryfall catalog — oracle_signals only.

poison.description: Poison counters. Produce via infect/toxic/get poison; payoffs care about poison. Bare proliferate is not a poison consumer.

rad.description: Rad counters. Produce via get/give rad; consume via remove/care about rad.

experience.description: Experience counters. Get them; spend via 'experience counters you have'.

speed.description: Speed (Start your engines!). Produce via starting engines; payoffs read max speed / your speed. Reminder 'Max speed is 4' is not a payoff.

monarch.description: The monarch. Become the monarch; payoffs if you're the monarch.

initiative.description: The initiative. Take the initiative; payoffs if you have the initiative.

citys_blessing.description: City's blessing via Ascend. Get the blessing; payoffs if you have it. Object name is city's blessing.

the_ring.description: The Ring. Produce via 'the Ring tempts you' as an effect; consume via whenever-tempts / Ring-bearer care.

interaction.description: Permission and answers counted via oracle signals until keyword coverage is enough.

go_wide_payoffs.description: Rewards many creatures — anthems, attack-for-each, lord effects. Token strategies often terminate here.

go_tall_payoffs.description: Concentrates power on few bodies — counters, equipment, single-target pumps. Tokens can feed this when one token is grown.

lineage.note: City's Blessing structure reused; Historic-shaped card-type gate on the new name.
Graveyard cardinality → graveyard diversity. Same zone, stricter set condition.
Board predicate on artifacts → board predicate on attached/countered creatures.
Cast-from-yard → cast-from-yard as the other face.
Face-down cheap body; ward-like turn-face-up tax replaces morph cost pattern.
Noncreature-spell trigger on a creature → same trigger as an ability word on any permanent/spell.
Attacked this turn → two or more nonlands entered this turn. Event-gate family.

lifegain_trigger.description: Fires when you (or a player) gain life — payoff node on a lifegain plan.
lifegain_trigger.note: 'gains life' also matches 'gains lifelink'. Granting lifelink is not a lifegain trigger. Every life terminator needs (?!link)\b — the lifelink false-positive fix fixed only the greedy pattern.

lifegain_source.description: Causes life gain — enabler density for lifegain payoffs. Lifelink is also an enabler via keyword family.

drain.description: Opponent loses life — pairs with lifegain for drain loops.

token_create.description: Broad token creation (creature or resource). Prefer creature_tokens / resource_tokens for plan graphs.

counterspell.description: Hard permission — interaction density for hold-the-fort plans.

creature_tokens.description: Creates creature tokens — increases board width. Primary enabler for go-wide.

resource_tokens.description: Makes any Treasure/Clue/Food-style resource token. Detector only — produces are on the per-subtype signals.
resource_tokens.note: old produces claimed treasure for every Food/Clue maker.

go_wide_payoff.description: Scales with number of creatures you control — the wide half of token math.
patterns: equal to the number of creatures you control

go_tall_payoff.description: +1/+1 counter growth on a creature — the tall half of token math. until-end-of-turn pumps are not counter placement; they stay honest empty rather than inventing counters.

counter_placement.note: 'enters with +1/+1 counters' places counters without saying put-on. Same shape as go_tall_payoff's enters-with arm; +1/+1 is required so charge/loyalty counters do not match.

enters.description: Triggers when a permanent enters the battlefield.

attacks.note: Collective 'whenever you attack' (Adeline, Firemane Commando) is not covered by the '~ attacks' arm alone.

leaves_battlefield.description: Triggers on leaving the battlefield. Consumes the actions that CAUSE leaving — exile (blink) and sacrifice — not the leave phrase itself.

blink.description: Exiles and returns permanents -- re-triggers enters abilities.
patterns: exile [\s\S]{0,120}?return (it|that card|those cards|them) to the battlefield
from your graveyard to the battlefield
from your graveyard to your hand

creature_token_maker.description: Creates creature tokens -- sacrifice fodder and board width.

patterns: cast an instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard

explosive_ramp.description: Rituals, mana doublers, mass treasure — doubles a turn's mana. Curve-spec sibling of ordinary ramp rocks; counted by curve.ramp_split().

proliferate.description: Adds to existing counters without placing new ones. Atraxa is the poster counters commander and counter_placement never fires on her.

sacrifice_trigger.description: Rewards the act of sacrificing, which is not the same as owning an outlet or seeing a death.

instant_or_sorcery_cast.description: Triggers on casting instants/sorceries. Bounded to one clause: 'whenever a player casts an instant' must hit, 'casts a creature spell' must not.
patterns: whenever [^.\n]{0,26}casts? (an instant|a sorcery|an instant or sorcery)

play_from_graveyard.description: Casts or plays cards from the graveyard as an ongoing permission, which graveyard_recursion's 'return target ... from your graveyard' never matches.

aura_or_equipment_cast.description: Rewards casting Auras/Equipment/Vehicles — the voltron engine.
aura_or_equipment_cast.verified_on: Sram, Senior Edificer; Wyleth, Soul of Steel

attach_to_commander.description: Moves or lands auras/equipment onto a creature.

artifact_matter.description: Counts or uses artifacts you control as a resource, not merely making one.
artifact_matter.verified_on: Urza, Lord High Artificer; Sharuum the Hegemon, Breya, Etherium Shaper

tax_opponent_spells.description: Raises opponents' costs — the stax axis.

symmetric_resource.description: Gives opponents resources — the group hug axis.

creature_type_matter.description: Rewards casting a specific creature TYPE. Generic card types are excluded -- 'another creature spell' is not tribal.

dies_trigger_doubler.description: Doubles death triggers without ever saying 'dies' the way dies_trigger matches.
patterns: a creature dying causes a triggered ability

etb_doubler.description: Doubles enters triggers without blinking anything itself.
patterns: a (permanent|creature) entering causes a triggered ability

token_doubler.description: Replaces token creation with more tokens; never says 'create', so creature_token_maker never fires.
patterns: tokens would be created .{0,30}those tokens plus

gained_life_this_turn.description: Keys off life gained this turn rather than a gain trigger, so lifegain_trigger never fires.
patterns: if you gained life this turn

tribal_type_matter.description: Cares about a specific creature TYPE you control, which is how most tribal commanders read -- Krenko counts Goblins, Wilhelt counts Zombies. creature_type_matter only caught the spell-casting shape.
tribal_type_matter.verified_on: Krenko, Wilhelt; Giada, Font of Hope, Lathril, Blade of the Elves

magecraft.description: Triggers on casting/copying instants and sorceries, including the named Magecraft keyword and 'first/second spell each turn'.
patterns: cast or copy an instant or sorcery

energy_gain.note: Oracle uses {E}; text is matched lowered so patterns use {e}.

poison_gain.description: Gives players poison counters (infect, toxic, or explicit get).
patterns: gets? a number of poison counters
get a number of poison counters

poison_care.description: Cares about poison counters on players. Bare proliferate is excluded on purpose.
patterns: has (?:three or more |\d+ or more |\d+ )?poison counters
have (?:three or more |\d+ or more |\d+ )?poison counters
poison_care.note: proliferate alone is not poison-directed. 'number of poison counters equal' on givers is produce, not care.

patterns: gets? (?:a |an |\d+|half x |that many |twice that many |x |four |two |three )?rad counters?
get (?:a |an |\d+|half x |that many |twice that many |x |four |two |three )?rad counters?
gets? a number of rad counters
get a number of rad counters

rad_care.description: Removes rad counters or cares about rad/radiation on players.

speed_start.description: Start your engines! — begins tracking speed.

speed_care.description: Max speed ability word, have max speed, or your speed scalar. Not reminder 'Max speed is 4'.
speed_care.note: reminder text says 'Max speed is 4' without a dash — excluded.

monarch_if.description: If/as long as you're the monarch — directed to you, not 'the monarch' as a noun alone.
patterns: as long as you're the monarch
as long as you are the monarch

citys_blessing_have.description: If you have the city's blessing.

ring_tempts.description: The Ring tempts you as an effect — not the whenever-tempts trigger.
ring_tempts.note: lookbehind excludes 'whenever the Ring tempts you' payoffs.

ring_care.description: Whenever the Ring tempts you, or Ring-bearer choice/control care.

enters_tapped.description: Permanent enters tapped — unconditional or conditional (unless / if you don't). Highest-frequency unread land line.
enters_tapped.verified_on: Path of Ancestry, Botanical Sanctum; near-miss Island, Walking Ballista enters-with-counters

pay_life_enter.description: Shock-land payment: as it enters, pay life or it enters tapped. Not an activation-cost pay-life.
patterns: as .{0,40}enters(?: the battlefield)?, you may pay \d+ life
you may pay \d+ life\. if you don't, (?:it|this land) enters(?: the battlefield)? tapped
pay_life_enter.verified_on: Blood Crypt; near-miss Shadowcloak Vampire Pay 2 life activation

pain_mana.description: Mana ability (or tap) deals damage to you — pain lands and talismans. Damage-to-you is not lose-life; produces/consumes stay empty on purpose.
pain_mana.verified_on: Karplusan Forest; near-miss Lightning Bolt (any target)

any_color_mana.description: Adds one mana of any color — fixed rainbow. Commander's color identity is a different signal.
patterns: add one mana of any color(?! in your commander)
any_color_mana.verified_on: Spire of Industry; near-miss Command Tower, Temple of Epiphany dual

commander_identity_mana.description: Adds mana of any color in your commander's color identity — Command Tower shape.
patterns: add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity
commander_identity_mana.verified_on: Command Tower; near-miss Spire of Industry any-color

land_sacrifice_value.description: Sacrifice this land for value — draw or fetch. Spell costs that sacrifice a land are excluded.
patterns: sacrifice this land: draw a card
sacrifice this land: search your library
land_sacrifice_value.verified_on: Horizon Canopy, Evolving Wilds; near-miss Harrow, War Room

commander_free_cast.description: If you control a commander, cast without paying mana cost — the free-cast cycle.
patterns: if you control a commander, you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost
commander_free_cast.verified_on: Deadly Rollick; near-miss can be your commander

commander_matters.description: Cares about casting your commander or the command zone — not color identity and not 'can be your commander'.
patterns: your commander from the command zone
commander_matters.verified_on: cast-from-command-zone exemplar; near-miss Command Tower, can-be-your-commander

enchant_creature.description: Aura enchant keyword targeting a creature. 'Enchanted creature' body text and Enchant land are near-misses.
enchant_creature.verified_on: Pacifism; near-miss Wild Growth, enchanted-creature body text

no_max_hand_size.description: You have no maximum hand size — Reliquary Tower / Thought Vessel.
no_max_hand_size.verified_on: Reliquary Tower, Thought Vessel; near-miss Storm Crow

card_draw.description: Draws cards — the primary card-advantage verb. Scry/tutor without draw is a near-miss.
card_draw.verified_on: Mind Stone; near-miss Path of Ancestry (scry)

tap_add_colored.description: {T}: Add one fixed colored mana. Dual 'or' and any-color are different signals.
tap_add_colored.verified_on: Boseiju, Who Endures; near-miss Hinterland Harbor, Command Tower

dual_mana_ability.description: {T}: Add color A or color B. Fixed single-color and rainbow are near-misses.
dual_mana_ability.verified_on: Hinterland Harbor; near-miss Boseiju, Spire of Industry

enchant_land.description: Aura Enchant land — Wild Growth class. Enchant creature is a near-miss.

cant_be_blocked.description: Unblockable — can't be blocked (optionally this turn / by …). Flying reminder 'can't be blocked except by flying' is excluded.
cant_be_blocked.verified_on: Rogue's Passage; near-miss Birds of Paradise / flying reminder

uncounterable.description: Spell or ability text that can't be countered. Counterspell itself is a near-miss.

modal_choose_one.description: Modal choose-one spells. Choose two / choose three are near-misses.

firebreathing.description: Activated +1/+0 until end of turn — classic firebreathing. +1/+1 pumps are near-misses.
patterns: : (?:this creature|~) gets \+1/\+0 until end of turn

must_attack.description: Attacks each combat if able. Tax/can't-attack effects are near-misses.
must_attack.verified_on: Toski, Bearer of Secrets; near-miss Propaganda

colorless_mana.description: {T}: Add {C} — colorless source. Fixed colored tap-add is a near-miss.

filter_mana.description: Pay mana (not {T}) to add a different color — filter abilities. Tap-add is a near-miss.

cant_block.description: This creature can't block. Defender (can't attack) is a near-miss.
cant_block.verified_on: can't-block shape; near-miss Wall of Omens

modal_choose_one_or_both.description: Modal choose one or both. Plain choose one is a near-miss.

top_library_look.description: Ongoing permission to look at the top of the library. Scry alone is a near-miss.
patterns: look at the top card of your library any time
play with the top card of your library revealed
top_library_look.verified_on: Oracle of Mul Daya; near-miss Path of Ancestry

destroy_target_creature.description: Targeted creature destruction. Mass 'destroy all creatures' is a near-miss.
destroy_target_creature.verified_on: Doom Blade; near-miss Wrath of God

activated_pump_plus.description: Activated +1/+1 until end of turn. Firebreathing +1/+0 is a near-miss.
patterns: : (?:this creature|~) gets \+1/\+1 until end of turn

grant_keyword_eot.description: Grants a keyword until end of turn. Static keyword lines are near-misses.
patterns: gains? (?:flying|first strike|double strike|trample|menace|deathtouch|lifelink|vigilance|haste|hexproof|indestructible|reach|shadow|fear|intimidate) until end of turn

tap_target.description: Tap target creature (often activated). Damage spells are near-misses.

exile_target_creature.description: Exile target creature. Destroy-target is a near-miss.
exile_target_creature.verified_on: Path to Exile; near-miss Doom Blade

choose_creature_type.description: As this permanent enters, choose a creature type. Bare changeling is a near-miss.
choose_creature_type.verified_on: Coat of Arms shape; near-miss Changeling Outcast

destroy_target_land.description: Destroy target land. Creature destruction is a near-miss.
destroy_target_land.verified_on: Strip Mine shape; near-miss Doom Blade

stays_tapped.description: Doesn't untap / may choose not to untap — freeze. Ordinary creatures are near-misses.

activated_ping.description: Activated ability deals damage to any target. Instant Lightning Bolt is a near-miss.
patterns: \{[^}]+\}: (?:this creature|~|[^\n]{0,40}) deals \d+ damage to any target
activated_ping.verified_on: Prodigal Sorcerer shape; near-miss Lightning Bolt

stat_pump_eot.description: Any +N/+M (or +N/-M) until end of turn. Shrink -N/-N is a near-miss.

shrink_target.description: Target creature gets -N/-N until end of turn. +N/+N pumps are near-misses.
patterns: target creature gets -[0-9xX]+/-[0-9xX]+ until end of turn

bounce_to_hand.description: Return a target permanent/creature to hand. Exile removal is a near-miss.
bounce_to_hand.verified_on: Flooded Shoreline; near-miss Path to Exile

prevent_damage.description: Prevent next N damage or all combat damage this turn. Lifegain is a near-miss.
patterns: prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn
prevent_damage.verified_on: Master Apothecary / Fog shape; near-miss Healing Salve gain-life

choose_color.description: As this permanent enters, choose a color. Choose-a-creature-type is a near-miss.
choose_color.verified_on: Caged Sun; near-miss Coat of Arms shape (creature type)

put_on_library.description: Put a target card/permanent on top or bottom of a library. Bounce to hand is a near-miss.

discard_additional_cost.description: As an additional cost, discard cards. Pay-life additional costs are near-misses.
patterns: as an additional cost to cast this spell, discard

choose_two.description: Modal choose-two. Choose-one is a near-miss.

leyline_start.description: May begin the game with this on the battlefield from opening hand. Ordinary enchantments are near-misses.
patterns: if .{0,80}in your opening hand, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield
leyline_start.verified_on: Leyline of Sanctity; near-miss Ghostly Prison

upkeep_sac_unless.description: Upkeep: sacrifice unless you pay. Ordinary upkeep triggers are near-misses.
upkeep_sac_unless.verified_on: Justice shape; near-miss Rhystic Study (upkeep ask, no sac)

relations.note: Creature tokens increase board width; anthems / for-each spend that width.
A token can be the body counters and pumps grow.
Tokens are cheap fuel for aristocrats sacrifice loops.
Death triggers often drain or gain life.
Lifelink is a rate modifier on the same life equation.
Yard casting / filling enables delirium and threshold.
Recursion keeps yard relevant and can refill types.
Convoke / improvise spend boards and artifacts tokens help make.
Discard outlets fill the yard for flashback-family engines.
Filtering finds the spells storm/cascade-like payoffs want.
Attack triggers scale when many bodies connect.
Connect triggers need a way through blockers.
Token makers retrigger ETB value; blink does too.
Permission and hexproof/ward are both survival math.
Skullclamp-class: +1/-1 equipment turns 1-toughness bodies into card advantage on death; token makers supply fodder.
Voltron: equipment stacks on the same threat counters and pumps grow.
EDH voltron/counters: grow one creature, then suit it up.
